title: Hurricane Florence Brunswick County Evacuations
description:
A team consisting of Coast Guard Maritime Safety and Security Team Miami, Coast Guard Tactical Law-Enforcement Team South, and Army 82nd Airborne Medium Tactical Vehicle members evacuate people from Boiling Spring Lake, Brunswick County, N.C., during rescue operational response to Hurricane Florence, Sept. 17, 2018.

The team members overcame adverse environmental conditions and mobility impediments, to reach citizens in distress and transport them to shelters with basic survival necessities. 

U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 3rd Class Trevor Lilburn.
keywords: MSST Miami, Brunswick County, TACLET South, Hurricane Florence, Boiling Spring Lake, Coast Guard, North Carolina, USCG, 82nd Airborne
